subject: Issue creating RRPP dataframe for use with lm.rrpp

messages.author: 96a78639336ed702
messages.subject: Issue creating RRPP dataframe for use with lm.rrpp
parts:
In vignette for geomorph v3.1.1, the following code was used to examine allometry:

library(geomorph)

data("larvalMorph")

Y.gpa <- gpagen(larvalMorph$tailcoords, curves = larvalMorph$tail.sliders, ProcD = FALSE, print.progress = FALSE)

gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(Y.gpa, treatment = larvalMorph$treatment, family = larvalMorph$family)

fit.size <- procD.lm(coords ~ log(Csize), data = gdf, print.progress = FALSE)

Since procD.lm is running lm.rrpp, I tried to do lm.rrpp by myself as follows:
gdf_rrpp <- rrpp.data.frame(coords = Y.gpa$coords, logSize = log(Y.gpa$Csize))

fit.size_rrpp <- lm.rrpp(coords ~ logSize, SS.type = "I", data = gdf_rrpp, print.progress = FALSE)

I was returned the error:
Error: It was not possible to find model terms in the global environment or the data frame used.

I wish to know where I was wrong in the code. Thank you.

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Issue creating RRPP dataframe for use with lm.rrpp
parts:
The coords are a 3D array and lm.rrpp can’t analyze data in that format. One of the purposes of procD.lm - the main purpose, actually - is to modify the data and deliver it to lm.rrpp as a matrix. 

Mike
